transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, what brings me in is that... I just keep dodging anything that even reminds me of my old job. I mean, I can't even go near office buildings or listen to security talks anymore. If there's a networking event near any of the work sites, I just don't go. And... if people start asking about the day it happened, I just make up some excuse and get out of there as fast as I can. It's just getting to be too much to handle on my own.
Have you been having intrusive memories, nightmares, or flashbacks about the event that happened at your old job?

Yes, I do get those. It happens completely out of nowhere, really. I'll just be standing at the sink washing dishes, or driving past a warehouse gate, and... the whole scene just pops right back into my head. It's so sharp. I can actually hear the panic in people's voices all over again, and my chest just tightens up exactly like I'm right back there.

latest_inference.note: The patient confirmed experiencing intrusive memories, flashbacks, and strong psychological distress upon exposure to cues related to the traumatic event, which aligns with PTSD (F43.10). No features suggesting a specific phobia (F40.00) alone were identified.
